# vcp_project_consumption (Data Source)

Reads what the project was charged over a period, broken down by service.

The period is counted in the partner's time zone (`time_zone`) and both ends are inclusive. It may be at most 366 days long.

~> While `is_final` is `false` the period reaches today and its amounts still grow as the day is billed: a plan run later can read a different `total`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What the project has been charged this month so far, per service.
data "vcp_project_consumption" "this_month" {}

# A closed period: is_final is true once the period ends before today.
data "vcp_project_consumption" "q3" {
  from = "2026-07-01"
  to   = "2026-09-30"
}

output "vstack_this_month" {
  value = one([
    for s in data.vcp_project_consumption.this_month.services : s.total if s.service == "vstack"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) First day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Defaults to the first day of the current month.
- `to` (String) Last day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Defaults to today. Must not be earlier than `from`.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency of the amounts — the project currency, as in `vcp_project`.
- `is_final` (Boolean) `false` while `to` is not earlier than today: the last day is still being billed.
- `services` (Attributes List) Amount per service, largest first. Only services charged in the period are listed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of the partner, in which the period dates are counted.
- `total` (Number) Amount charged to the project over the period; the sum of `services` and of the days of `vcp_project_consumption_daily` for the same period.

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `service` (String) Billed service: `vstack`, `vmware`, `kubernetes`, `vpn`, `cloud_director`, `ssl_certificates`, `unoc_v1`, `unoc_v2`, `monitoring`, `object_storage`, `cdn`, `llm`, `managed_servers`, `vdi`, `streaming`. New services are added to the set over time.
- `total` (Number) Amount charged for the service over the period.
